outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and aligns with the upper drawer handle in frames 0–84 (image, left_ego_image, wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward in frames 101–120 (image, left_ego_image). By frames 126–138, the drawer is visibly extended with its side and open space exposed, and remains open as the gripper withdraws (left_ego_image, wrist_image). No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or displacement of unrelated tabletop objects is visible.
